models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
technicalNotes:
Depending on the Generation of the Airbag Control Module this Fault Code may be reset/cleared up to 2 times. If the Code is stored another time, the Control Module will store a different Fault Code (Control Module: Faulty) and needs to be replaced.
Specific Details (i.e. under which Circumstances the Module would need to be replaced or can be reused) can be found in the Factory Repair Manual for each Model.
